cohort: 3010 pregnant women from Vancouver, Edmonton, Winnipeg and Toronto between 2008 and 2012
finding: Breastfeeding initiation and continuation rates were similar between Canadian-born and non-Canadian-born women, but factors associated with these outcomes differed between the groups.
mod_finding: Caesarean birth was associated with lower rates of breastfeeding initiation and cessation at 6 months postpartum.
